entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I bought, and I've been on hold forever. This is absolutely ridiculous! I want to get this done now.
I certainly understand your frustration with the wait time, and I can definitely help you with a return. Do you happen to have the order number handy?
No, I don't! You should be able to find it with my phone number. This shouldn't be so difficult. Just look it up.

Of course. I can do that. One moment while I pull up your account. Okay, I see an order here from about 82 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
The issue is I don't want it! The color is completely wrong, it looks nothing like it did online. It was a gift and the box is still unopened. It was never even used!
I see. Thank you for clarifying that. Let me just review the return eligibility for you.

Review it? What's there to review?! Your policy is 90 days! I'm within the window. Are you trying to weasel out of this? I will write a review so scathing it'll sink your company. Put your manager on the phone right now!

There's no need for that, sir. I apologize for the confusion. You are absolutely correct. Our policy for standard items is indeed 90 days, and since you received the helmet 82 days ago, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh. Well, fine then. That's what I thought. So what happens now?

I've just approved the return in our system. I am sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file for you right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off.
And I'll get a full refund?

Yes, a full refund to your original payment method once the item is received at our warehouse. We take rider safety very seriously, and we want to ensure you're completely satisfied with your gear, including the color. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No. Just make sure that email comes through.
It has been sent. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
